audit.headline_critique: Value prop is strong ('The open-source AI agent desktop app') but the hero is visually static with a flat code mockup and standard download button.
friction_points: Static hero does not showcase the agent's real-time reasoning and multi-file tree manipulation.
Users have to mentally simulate what using the app feels like instead of experiencing the velocity upfront.
Competitors like Cursor / Windsurf / Devin use slick dynamic simulations to hook developers immediately.
audit.proposed_solution: Interactive 3D Agent Workflow Hero: A live interactive node visualizer in Three.js where developers can click 'Trigger Agent', see the agent parse an AST tree in real-time 3D, and interact with the code diffing preview directly inside the browser viewport.

audit.headline_critique: High-ticket hardware ($5,900 price point) currently represented by 2D webp cutouts ('core-silver-cut.webp'). Flat images lack tactile luxury feel required to close $5.9k impulse reservations.
friction_points: For a $5,900 hardware product, customers demand to inspect ports, chassis material, cooling vents, and internal modularity.
Current page has cost comparison graphs and app store cards, but the physical hardware hero is static.
Crowdfunding is currently LIVE on Kickstarter (ends Nov 12, 2026), making high conversion urgency critical right now.
audit.proposed_solution: Interactive 3D WebGL Hardware Configurator: Direct 360° orbital rotation of the Companion Core chassis, interactive color finish toggle (Charcoal vs. Silver Anodized), and an 'Exploded Architecture' mode exposing the internal compute board and private storage bays.

leads.name: zCAD AI
leads.category: Generative AI for 3D CAD & Parametric Engineering

audit.headline_critique: A company building Generative 3D CAD has a 2D particle banner in their hero instead of actual 3D geometry. It's a missed dogfooding opportunity.
friction_points: Engineering leads expect immediate proof that the CAD engine can render and slice parametric geometry in real time.
Abstract particle background looks like a generic SaaS template rather than deep engineering tech.
No interactive demo before asking for signup/waitlist.
audit.proposed_solution: Live Interactive Parametric CAD Viewport Hero: An embedded Three.js / WebGL viewport where visitors can tweak parametric sliders (radius, extrusion, twist, tolerance) and see real CAD meshes generate and animate in real time in the browser.
